caseName: Chase Brass & Copper Co. v. Franchise Tax Board of California
caseNameFull: Chase Brass & Copper Co. v. Franchise Tax Board of California

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. Cal., 1st App. Dist. Motions of Tax Executives Institute, Inc., Financial Executives Institute, and National Association of Manufacturers of the United States et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Appeal dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken , as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
